simple.meaning: שׁוּל (shûwl) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a skirt ; by implication, a bottom edge.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 28:33. The surrounding context includes death, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שׁוּל (H7757) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: a skirt ; by implication, a bottom edge
definitions.full: H7757. shul [ שׁוּל ] noun masculine Isa 6:1 skirt, of robe ; — plural construct שׁוּלֵי Exod 28:34 +; suffix שׁוּלַיִךְ Nahum 3:5 +, שׁוּלָיו Isa 6:1 +, שׁוּלֶיהָ Lam 1:9 ; — skirts ; of ׳י s train, in vision Isa 6:1 ; elsewhere of city personified as woman, in phrase of ignominy, שׁוּלַיִךְ חָשַׂפְתִּי Jer 13:26 , שׁ ׳גִּלֵּתִי עַלמָּֿנַיִךְ Nahum 3:5 , שׁ ׳נִגְּלוּ ׳ונו Jer 13:22 ; of defilement, ׳בְּשׁ טֻמְאָתָהּ Lam 1:9 ; of high priest's robe Exod 28:33 (twice in verse); 28:34 = 39:24-25 , 26 (all P). שׁוֺלָל see שׁלל .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to hang down;

occurrences.englishText: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:
On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:
a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.
They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.
They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;
a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
In the year that king Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
If you say in your heart,
Therefore I will also uncover your skirts on your face,
Her filthiness was in her skirts.
“Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.
